description:
Use this when the user wants to know what clipping a video will cost before anything runs: "how much will it
        take to clip this stream", "what will that use". Returns the Horizon Units (HU) that find_clips, find_moments or
        clip_range would spend on project_id: the whole video, or only range_start to range_end in seconds (0 and 0 =
        the whole video), with the minutes it covers. Spends and reserves nothing (request_key is optional). Show the number to the user and wait for their approval, then pass the approved
        number as max_hu to the tool that spends.
        Not for: starting the job (find_clips, find_moments, clip_range) or pricing an edit (edits cost no HU). Free.
name: estimate_hu
title: Quote the clipping cost (Horizon Units)
